us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: FBI investigates apparent hack of national criminal justice database
bullets: AP reported the NCIC database was apparently targeted.
The FBI opened an investigation into the incident.
The database supports law enforcement checks nationwide.

articles.title: Trump says Putin wants to end war as Russia rejects Kushner progress claims
bullets: Trump discussed Ukraine diplomacy during a White House news conference.
Russia rejected Kushner’s claims of progress in talks.
The remarks followed renewed U.S. diplomatic engagement on Ukraine.

articles.title: Trump criticizes credit card companies in Fox interview
bullets: Trump said credit card companies have profited heavily.
The comments came during a live Fox interview.
Axios included the remarks in its Sunday morning briefing.

articles.title: Pentagon information access questioned after Iran war
bullets: The Atlantic reported new concerns over Pentagon transparency.
The report cited limits on congressional travel support.
Officials estimated war operations and munitions replacement at about $48 billion.

articles.title: White House debates definition of ultra-processed food
bullets: The administration has debated a federal definition of ultra-processed food.
Officials weighed possible economic effects of follow-on policies.
HHS referred questions to the White House.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major world stories and international developments

articles.title: Russian attack near Kyiv kills two and wounds four
bullets: A Russian strike hit an apartment building near Ukraine’s capital.
Authorities said at least two people were killed.
Four others were wounded in the attack.

articles.title: EU and Indonesia sign trade deal after decade of negotiations
bullets: Reuters reported the agreement was signed on November 21.
The deal followed about ten years of negotiations.
It adds to the EU’s Asia trade agenda.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

articles.title: Denmark urges EU travel curbs on Russians after foiled plot
bullets: Denmark pressed EU partners to tighten Russian travel restrictions.
Reuters linked the push to a foiled plot.
The issue was reported from Paris on November 21.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

articles.title: Fire brought under control at Iraq’s Hartha power station
bullets: Iraq’s state news agency said civil defence teams contained the fire.
The incident occurred north of Basra.
Reuters reported from the scene in Gulf Times coverage.

articles.title: EU budget chair proposes new cuts and digital tax
bullets: EU leaders’ chair proposed further cuts to the 2028–2034 budget draft.
The proposal also suggested a digital tax.
France called the latest proposal very disappointing.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India headlines and regional developments

articles.title: Seven killed as truck collides with car in Gujarat’s Kutch
bullets: A speeding truck collided with a car in Kutch.
The Indian Express reported seven deaths.
The story led its India live updates on November 22.

articles.title: India and China commanders meet to calm Arunachal frontier
bullets: Indian Express listed the meeting in its November 22 archive.
Commanders discussed tensions along the Arunachal frontier.
The talks focused on calming the border situation.

articles.title: Nepal prime minister’s India visit leads November 22 headlines
bullets: Dainik Jagran listed Nepal PM’s India visit among top headlines.
The visit was highlighted with other national stories.
The roundup was published on November 22.

articles.title: Rishabh Pant century powers India against New Zealand
bullets: Pant scored his ninth Test century.
India reached 629 for six at lunch on day four.
The match was against New Zealand at Basin Reserve.

articles.title: India’s net oil and gas import bill jumps in October
bullets: India’s net oil and gas import bill rose 60% year over year.
The October bill reached $16 billion.
PPAC data cited Brent averaging $124.77 a barrel.

articles.title: Nasdaq dives as AI stocks sell off
bullets: Kiplinger reported the Nasdaq fell 1,261 points.
AI-related names led the selloff.
The decline capped a dismal week for major indexes.

articles.title: Nvidia slides after Reuters reports SEC accounting probe
bullets: Reuters reported the SEC is examining potential accounting issues.
Nvidia shares plunged sharply on Friday.
The stock had its worst week since 2008, according to market roundups.

articles.title: Anthropic’s post-IPO stumble hits AI trade
bullets: Anthropic fell after its much-watched market debut.
Reuters called the move a reality check for AI stocks.
The decline added pressure to broader technology shares.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

articles.title: Tesla shares slide as market selloff overshadows upgrade
bullets: StreetInsider listed Tesla among Friday’s notable decliners.
The broader market selloff weighed on the stock.
The move came despite an HSBC upgrade.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 and hits two-year low
bullets: Reuters reported Bitcoin dropped below $60,000.
A later item said it reached its lowest level in two years.
The decline tracked broader risk-asset weakness.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

articles.title: Spain to extend banking tax to fund housing policies
bullets: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced the plan Saturday.
The banking tax extension would support housing policies.
Reuters reported the announcement from Madrid.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

articles.title: Missouri judge approves Bayer’s $7.25 billion Roundup settlement
bullets: A Missouri judge approved Bayer’s Roundup settlement.
The deal is valued at $7.25 billion.
Reuters reported the ruling on November 20.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

articles.title: Stellantis recalls more than 82,000 Ram trucks
bullets: Stellantis recalled 82,843 Chrysler Ram pickups.
The issue involves anti-lock brake software risk.
Reuters reported the recall on November 20.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

articles.title: Verlinvest to buy China Resources’ stake in Oatly
bullets: Belgium’s Verlinvest agreed to buy China Resources’ Oatly stake.
The deal concerns the oat milk maker’s ownership structure.
Reuters reported the agreement from New York.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

articles.title: GTCR explores takeover of Global Payments
bullets: GTCR is exploring a potential takeover of Global Payments.
Reuters cited sources familiar with the matter.
The report was published on November 20.
articles.source: Reuters via Global Banking & Finance Review

articles.title: AI leaders warn of a 2027 reckoning
bullets: Axios interviewed leaders across government, AI, business and cyber.
Officials worry government expertise is lagging AI advances.
The report frames AI preparedness as a national security issue.

articles.title: Tech outages pile up as AI raises cybersecurity stakes
bullets: AP reported recent disruptions across government and private systems.
Experts cited AI’s role in both attack and defense.
Google warned hackers are using more sophisticated AI techniques.

articles.title: AI-generated cyberattack targeted European Union institution
bullets: An EU official confirmed an AI-generated cyberattack.
The incident was first detected on October 22.
Some digital tools remained offline weeks later.

articles.title: AI finds critical security flaws in NGINX
bullets: Researchers found serious NGINX vulnerabilities using AI.
TechRadar said the flaws could be exploited to steal data.
CISA warned organizations to patch immediately.

articles.title: Trump threatens tax on overseas AI data centers
bullets: AP reported Trump threatened a tax on foreign AI data centers.
The stance highlights tensions over AI infrastructure expansion.
The item appeared in AP’s November 21 technology summary.
